item.name: get policy analytics breakdown by dimension

query.description: (Required) dimension to break down by: policy_id, install_id, owner_type

request.description: Returns policy evaluation counts broken down by a single dimension (policy_id, install_id, or owner_type), sorted by violation count (denies first, then warns). Use this to identify which policies, installs, or lifecycle stages produce the most violations.
